implementation.units: One source spatial unit = one block. Velocity is blocks/sec, acceleration is blocks/sec^2, step dt is seconds and return is displacement. Caller may use20Hz without changing profile numbers.
implementation.state: Persist source Ammo/User ids, heading, full velocity, seconds, lateral friction, initial-brake completion, recoverable tracking gate and permanent guidance loss. Parent entity owns launch position, target UUID and error-space transform.
implementation.cadence: Per weapon/socket clock; inactive Shoot windows still decrement clock. Only successful spawn consumes cooldown. No catch-up batch. At20Hz high fire rates are capped at20 successful updates/sec; intermediate rates are quantized to update boundaries.
implementation.numericAdaptation: Double precision integration, finite-value/NBT guards, and <=8 ULP zero snapping for cadence subtraction prevent an extra whole MC tick from binary roundoff; not original float-bit replay.
implementation.userMapping: AntiTank and AntiAir FIG tracks both use motherVomit_AntiAir_user_ai. perfectTracking skips targeting error, while user.deadReckoning independently enables intercept lead.

remaining: Weapon user accuracy sampling/ground projection, original target acquisition and final Mouth attachment basis are handled separately, not guessed by this helper.
Caller must preserve source swept first hit with block/real-body contact and friendly/PvP protection.
Caller must choose explicit MC damage/knockback/presentation adapters; no guessed blast radius.
